description.value: strEATS is a Canadian fast-casual chain serving globally-inspired street foods — tacos, poutines, perogies, and more — made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The Willoughby location sits in a town centre retail complex in Langley. The brand emphasizes environmental sustainability through eco-friendly packaging and gives back to local communities through its Streats4Streets taco donation program.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 34m; bollard (2 spaces) at 36m; stands (4 spaces) at 60m; stands (6 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m; rack (7 spaces) at 93m. Total: 23 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's order page explicitly lists 'Streats Willoughby (Langley)' as an active ordering location, confirming this franchise location is real and open. The site describes globally-inspired street foods made with fresh ingredients and offers online ordering, supporting a takeout-oriented operation. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website URL was discovered with medium confidence; however, the order page explicitly names 'Streats Willoughby (Langley)', corroborating the OSM record.
No location-specific phone number is available — the website only lists a corporate toll-free number (1.800.661.2123) and a Calgary head office address. OSM also has no phone on file.
The store locator page returned 'No results found', likely due to JavaScript dependency; the order page confirms the location exists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active chain restaurant confirmed open via the website's order page listing the Willoughby (Langley) location. Useful to touring cyclists as a food stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website's contact page address (3048 – 9th Street SE, Calgary, AB) is the corporate head office, not the Langley location. The OSM address (20689 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Unit A150, Langley) is the correct local address.
